favourite.heading: Why Texas A&M can pull away
bullets: Texas A&M is the better football team by 12.9 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+12.9 pts).
Playing at Texas A&M is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Texas A&M by 1.1 points: ball control vs front disruption (+1.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Kentucky can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 -6.0 to p90 +39.0 for Texas A&M, so a projection of +18.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
